source_policy: Objective and baseline reward inventories are cross-checked against published quest guides and DLC catalogs. Reward-slot attribution and exact drop rates remain unresolved until independently reconciled.
notes: Canonical quest titles and objective structure are based on the current Steam quest guide and corroborating GameFAQs records.
DLC provenance is preserved at the record level.
